description: Warn N days before an ad account runs out of money, for one client or all clients. Use it for requests like 'warn me two days before the balance runs out'. Without client and scope it returns a question listing the clients; ask the user which one.

client_name.description: Client name or part of it, when scope is client.

days.description: Days of balance left when the warning fires, 0.5 to 30.

reset.description: true removes the setting and restores the default thresholds.

scope.description: client (one client) or all (every client of the workspace).

name: balance_alert_lead_time_set
